[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Lean.Data.String

def implementation (string: String) : List Nat :=
let notes := string.splitOn " ";
notes.map (fun note =>
  match note with
  | "o" => 4
  | "o|" => 2
  | ".|" => 1
  | _ => 0)
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma map_split_on_length
(string: String)
(notes: List String)
: string.splitOn " ".length = notes.length :=
by
induction' notes
  case nil
    simp
  case cons hd tl ih
    simp [String.splitOn_cons, ih]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation string
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
have h_notes := map_split_on_length string result
simp [h_notes]
use (List.zipWith (fun note result => not_map note = result) result (string.splitOn " "))
split
intro i h_i_lt_length
simp at h_i_lt_length
have h_notes_i := List.nthm result i h_i_lt_length
have h_note := List.nthm (string.splitOn " ") i h_i_lt_length
simp [h_notes_i, h_note]
[END]
